056_exclusion.rule: A valid boundary excludes its declared opposing orientation; it does not mutate the source orientation family.

057_orientation.identity_rule: Full typed equality includes all required fields.
057_orientation.inverse_rule: Exchange source and target domain/primitive roles; preserve relation and context.
057_orientation.self_inverse_exception: A genuinely identical source/target typed orientation may be self-inverse.

060_recursive_domain_lift.mto_selector: Lexicographic ordering of primitive identifiers within the finite candidate model.
060_recursive_domain_lift.history_policy: Retain original aspect sequence separately from resolved RT output.
060_recursive_domain_lift.otm_output: Ordered primitive sequence; repeated primitive occurrences are preserved.
060_recursive_domain_lift.termination: Reject continuation beyond the declared finite depth limit with DEPTH_LIMIT.
060_recursive_domain_lift.empty_input: Return EMPTY_INPUT; do not synthesize an RT.

falsification_policy: Any broader model that violates these frozen rules is a counterexample to this specification, not grounds for silent repair.
